question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce9ea1d6adecf4b07152faa20ef8bcf9b4e8d7496e6b3a938ec434dcb788b032.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

The above shape has increased 1 line and forms triangle to square, square to pentagon, pentagon to hexagon, hexagon to Heptagon.

The bottom lines are increasing by + 1 in next boxes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed480fef3445b35a1868c339e4cd2aedfc99e2a16f599248c2ae692944495b78.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
